items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: There was a fella named Joe "Ziggy" Johnson at the Grand Terrace. that produced the shows

ctx.x: Right on the floor. Yes. And nobody knew anything, and he got a little carried away, disturbed because of the fact, you know. And his lieutenants were stationed all over there, in the dark, the lights out naturally -- the show's going on. Because in those days, we had a production, you know; when we said floor show, we meant floor show -- opening number, comedians, singers, dancers, a line of girls -- twelve girls, you know. And we had to all those things; [it was easy] with Fletcher play for (unintelligible)…
